title: Skip the Yunnan Tour Bus — Travel the Tea-Horse Road to 3,300 m | China Travel Expert
description:
Most people see Yunnan from a package-tour bus. There's a better way: travel the old Tea-Horse Road yourself, Dali to Shangri-La — the caravan route where traders once hauled tea over the passes for centuries.

Unlike Tibet, Yunnan needs no special permit and no mandatory guide, so you can go independently. The route climbs from about 2,400 m up to 3,300 m and runs right past Tiger Leaping Gorge — roughly 3,790 m deep from peak to river, one of the deepest canyons on earth. Go your own way and you stop where you want; the bus never does.

🧭 Expert Tip: break the climb with a night in Lijiang (~2,400 m) before pushing up to Shangri-La (~3,300 m) — it helps you acclimatize and avoid altitude headaches.

别只坐云南跟团大巴——自己走茶马古道,大理到香格里拉,一路爬到3300米。
